in_sanskrit.name: Appu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Small, Petite
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Appu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Appu is derived from the Tamil word 'appadi' which means 'small' or 'petite'. It is also a common nickname for children named Appadurai, Appan, or Arapporan. In Hindu mythology, Appu is also the name of a celestial being associated with the Sun and represents energy, power, and vitality.
